extractions.method: Logistic-regression in-game win probability with 10 state variables

tier_2_model_card.model: iWinRNFL logistic regression for running home-team win probability
tier_2_model_card.training_window: last 7 NFL seasons obtained through league API
tier_2_model_card.reported_result: 75% winner-projection accuracy versus 63% for a baseline pre-game model; abstract says probabilities are well-calibrated

calibration_analysis.focus: Explicitly described as well-calibrated; compares in-game probabilities with baseline and evaluates nonlinear alternatives.
calibration_analysis.metric_or_finding: Abstract reports well-calibrated probabilities and no significant improvement from more complex nonlinear models.

extractions.method: Favorite-longshot bias in prediction-market returns

tier_2_model_card.model: Empirical return analysis of favorite and longshot purchases on Polymarket
tier_2_model_card.finding: Purchases below 10 cents lose 19.3 cents per dollar while purchases at or above 90 cents earn 0.83 cents; sports did not show the robust two-sided pattern seen in crypto/politics.

sgp_parlay_data.focus: Betting-market pricing bias, not SGP/parlay correlation.
sgp_parlay_data.relevance_note: Useful market-pricing diagnostic but not a same-game parlay model.

extractions.method: Noisy-probability odds model generating favorite-longshot bias

tier_2_model_card.model: Buyer/seller binary-option odds model with multiple noisy degrees of belief
tier_2_model_card.finding: Zero-expectation agreed odds differ from odds based on reciprocal average probabilities; the favorite-longshot bias emerges from the noisy-belief setup.

sgp_parlay_data.focus: General betting-market odds theory; no parlay or SGP dependence model.

extractions.method: Pathwise calibration benchmark for live win probabilities

tier_2_model_card.model: Continuous-path benchmark and probability-integral-transform diagnostic for the highest win probability attained by the eventual loser
tier_2_model_card.data: Public regular-season NFL and NBA feeds, 2018-2024
tier_2_model_card.finding: No global departure detected in NFL; systematic excess of extreme losing-team peaks detected in NBA.

calibration_analysis.focus: Pathwise/sequential calibration benchmark for live win-probability feeds.
calibration_analysis.metric_or_finding: Exact continuous-path benchmark, conservative discrete-path bound, PIT diagnostic, and first-crossing test at published 0.95 win probability.

extractions.method: Verifiable-reward calibration of NFL in-game win probability

tier_2_model_card.model: Label-free state-conditioned empirical win-rate reward for probabilistic forecasting; NFL in-game win probability testbed with betting market reference
tier_2_model_card.finding: A 7B model trained with the reward reached betting-market calibration by direct prediction and outperformed a zero-shot frontier model on calibration; tabular estimator matched Brier score.

calibration_analysis.focus: Calibration is the central outcome; compares model forecasts with market and tabular estimator using Brier score/calibration.
calibration_analysis.metric_or_finding: Abstract states the market retains a small live in-game information edge beyond shared inputs.

extractions.method: Leave-one-out residual prediction intervals in high-dimensional linear regression

tier_1_method_card.setting: Linear regression with many variables, including robust M-estimators, James-Stein estimators and penalized estimators such as LASSO
tier_1_method_card.guarantee: Uniform asymptotic validity conditional on the training sample under minimal assumptions on error distribution and high-dimensional design
tier_1_method_card.sports_transfer: Core regression uncertainty method; no sports application in the abstract.

extractions.method: Asymptotic risk calibration for non-monotone loss/acceptance scores

tier_1_method_card.method: A-CRC-QA post-hoc calibration inspired by conformal risk control for a non-monotone instance-wise loss
tier_1_method_card.guarantee: Targets asymptotic rather than finite-sample risk control because the loss is generally non-monotone in the threshold
tier_1_method_card.sports_transfer: Directly relevant to calibration designs with non-monotone betting or decision scores, but evaluated on QA rather than sports.

calibration_analysis.metric_or_finding: Linear expectation constraint and monotonized empirical-risk calibration; favorable reliability/retention tradeoff on CoQA and MedMCQA.
